newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal higher, soyoil down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal higher, soyoil down on profit-taking.

text.p: Profit-taking on soyoil/soymeal spreads pushed soymeal futures off session lows in early trade, traders said.
Near the open May, soymeal was down as much as $3.00 per ton before spread profit taking trimmed losses, traders said.
Early soymeal pressure also was expected to come from talk China may be seeking South American soymeal and a weaker soymeal market in Rotterdam, pit traders said.
At 1022 CDT, soymeal was down $0.60 to up $1.00 a ton, with July steady at $267.80 per ton. Soyoil was down 0.05 to 0.14 cent per lb, with July down 0.14 at 24.95 cents.
